verdict.rationale: Orb's docs say it tracks accrued revenue before invoices are issued, triggers alerts at usage thresholds, and offers an API to create alerts on a customer's credit balance. Real-time webhooks can push those alerts out. The evidence covers alerting and internal accrual tracking, but does not show customers or the team seeing current-cycle usage and cost live. Missing for 10: a customer-facing usage/cost view (portal or embeddable dashboard), explicit real-time current-cycle usage display, independent or hands-on corroboration of alert behavior.
